key_insight: AI can unify fragmented experimental and theoretical evidence to diagnose, model, and mitigate instability in all-inorganic perovskites such as CsPbX3.
engineering_relevance: The review points to AI as a practical tool for designing more stable perovskite devices by guiding material selection, reliability prediction, and degradation-resistant engineering strategies.
method: Microscopic mechanism analysis across coupled degradation pathways
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes multimodal data, sparse statistics, protocol dependence, and uncertainty quantification as central challenges that AI can help address.
watch_item: Current AI methods remain limited by data quality, inconsistent benchmarks, interpretability gaps, and weak transferability across domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
